Cookie Policy

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your browser when you visit. They help the website remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

2. Cookies We Use

We use minimal cookies. Our website has no tracking, advertising, or third-party marketing cookies. We use Vercel Web Analytics, which collects anonymous usage data in a privacy-friendly, cookie-free manner.

3. Your Control

You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Please see your browser's help section. Disabling cookies may affect certain features of our website.

4. Updates

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.
